resources.string: See and control your child\'s phone.
For the Parent\'s phone to reach this one with the screen off, Sophiel needs Android not to limit its battery.

The server keeps only accounts, sessions and pairings. It passes messages along without being able to read them (encrypted with a key that never leaves the two phones) and never stores the Log, app lists or commands. No image or screen content ever leaves this phone. The QR scanner (Google) sends anonymous usage data to Google.
